todo_list.content: Read original sources and record selected Story targets
todo_list.active_form: Reading source evidence and target baselines
instructions: Load ceaia-sdlc-story-spec-generation and its workflow contract, source intake and shared quality standard. Use the JSON-first Jira-backed Story route and trusted platform identity; never ask for staffId. Retained confirmed Jira success needing only profile recovery goes directly to exporter closeout, bypassing new preparation and submission gates without fabricating history or replaying Jira.

Read the persistent user Workspace profile using supported file tools or native save/open/read actions executable by this agent. A special tool name, visible call or scope marker is unnecessary. For new work with no applicable profile, ask missing source, project, then supported optional extras (explicit skip allowed); record the actual optionalFieldsDecision before authoring. Supplied source/project do not answer that question. With saved settings, obtain current-run Use/Change/project-switch approval once for the unchanged batch/resume.

Follow the generation intake/path contract: classify new_story versus existing_ticket_update, confirm sources, preserve original evidence and attachment bindings, distinguish relationship-only targets, and retain all selected ready/pending candidates. Resolve outputRoot/historyRoot and initialize/read back actual internal state before normal generation; not-found permits initialization. Resume preserves counters, scored paths and remote outcomes.
completion_criteria: Selected targets, original evidence, readiness/gaps and resolved internal state are recorded, or precise persistence blockers are retained. No Story score is required at intake; confirmed-success profile-only recovery follows the direct closeout route.

todo_list.content: Assemble final Story JSON, review and score each ready candidate
todo_list.active_form: Reusing Jira configuration, synchronizing JSON/SPEC and recording actual scores
instructions: Follow generation assembly and production rules using actual profile/baseline facts. Query only missing, changed or genuinely rejected configuration; reuse current metadata across candidates without treating create metadata as edit permission. Honor optionalFieldsDecision before authoring, fixed Story type, mandatory fields.project/issuetype, exact update target and confirmed attachment mappings. Synchronize authoritative story.json4jira, Markdown SPECs and tests before review/score.

Use the existing production precheck once and invoke the bundled read-only ceaia-spec-review with complete original evidence and actual current artifacts. Do not add a second Task-level content validator, report or repair loop. Apply only the existing bounded repair policy, synchronize review headers before scoring, and avoid rewriting already matching content.

Call nodejs-base-mcp.scoreUserStory only for a required assessment with exactly story_json_workspace_path, specFileStatus=Pass and specFilePath. Persist the complete actual response and input/revision binding, then freeze JSON/SPECs. Reuse current reads, scores and the existing preparation.md Plan/Assembly sections; number only actual review/score/export invocations. Resume/save retries never cause unchanged rescoring.
completion_criteria: Every selected unsubmitted candidate has complete current JSON/tests/SPECs, actual setup decision, independent content PASS and a persisted passing 76-100 assessment, or its scope was explicitly changed/stopped. Preserve all pending scope and real attempt state. Confirmed-success profile-only recovery does not require reconstructed preparation/review/score evidence.

todo_list.content: Reconcile selected scope and obtain current upload-content confirmation
todo_list.active_form: Checking global coverage and presenting scored JSON previews
instructions: Reconcile every selected obligation, supported exclusion and pending item using actual batch state. Do not silently omit blocked candidates or change scope; integrated export requires zero pending obligations and current evidence bindings.

Verify current review/score/JSON/SPEC/assembly evidence by reusing complete unchanged reads rather than rerunning Skill checks. Preparation-only ends with actual artifacts and score results. Load the exporter handoff/preview procedure for export intent; changed content returns only to affected upstream work.

Present actual scored .json4jira files and attachment operations; obtain explicit confirmation bound to current JSON/SPEC revisions, separate from earlier settings approval. Use actual file links and friendly wording: Please review these Story and SPEC files, including the content, project and attachment operations. Confirm export when everything looks right, or tell me what you would like to change. Silence is never confirmation.
completion_criteria: Selected scope is reconciled and, for export intent, the user has explicitly confirmed the current frozen scored files and attachment operations. No additional score invocation is required for unchanged inputs.

todo_list.content: Submit only the JSON path and verify backend operation results
todo_list.active_form: Exporting frozen JSON packages and recording backend persistence
instructions: Execute ceaia-sdlc-jira-export. For retained confirmed issue success needing only profile recovery, go directly to workspace-profile.md using known verified facts; do not require a new handoff, preview, JSON/SPEC reread, score or Jira call. For new submissions, reuse current confirmation, perform the required final read-back and submit the unchanged scored JSON path without discovery, conversion or payload regeneration.

Call java-base-mcp.exportjirabydynamicfield with only story_json_workspace_path, identical to the passing score input. Process confirmed files serially; preserve actual issue, attachment/replacement, database-link, queue and async score-sync outcomes under the exporter recovery policy. Never replay successful/unknown remote writes or add the legacy association call.

After confirmed issue create/update, complete profile closeout before returning or starting another Jira item, even if downstream effects are partial: fresh-read the actual user destination, preserve other entries, merge useful verified configuration, write populated JSON and read it back through supported tools/native actions. Report saved only after verifying contents; identify the actual failed/missing operation, never infer unavailable from tool names or hidden calls. Recovery retries only persistence. Stop later Jira submissions for unresolved required effects; return current deliverables and precise statuses, keeping internal records out of the default deliverable list.
completion_criteria: Actual Jira/attachment/linkage/queue outcomes and async synchronization status are recorded separately; required local/profile persistence is verified or precisely reported pending/failed/unavailable. No fully complete claim hides missing effects, and no remote operation is replayed to repair persistence.

outputs.name: Reviewed and scored handoff
outputs.description: The current scored Story JSON, SPEC and test package with existing review/score evidence; a logical output, not an extra handoff file.

outputs.name: Jira export results
outputs.description: Verified Jira, attachment, linkage, queue, score-sync and profile-persistence outcomes in existing result/state records.

acceptance_criteria.description: Newly prepared selected Story packages meet the required current independent review and 76-100 score threshold; profile-only recovery preserves confirmed historical results without rerunning scoring.

For export intent, only current user-confirmed packages are submitted, and actual remote outcomes plus meaningful profile read-back or precise persistence blockers are reported. Preparation-only makes no Jira-success claim.
